description:
A high-energy and inspiring Rotaract Installation Ceremony was successfully held at G.D. Jalan College, marking the beginning of a powerful new year of service, leadership and learning!

Leadership Handover & Vision:
* Incoming President Rtr. Laksh Pujari delivered an inspiring address, unveiling an impactful project lineup for the year while encouraging all members to step up and participate actively.
* Immediate Past President Rtr. Chirag Yadav was recognized for his outstanding leadership and successful tenure. President Laksh announced that key initiatives from IPP Chirag’s term will continue this year.
* RCBK President Rtn. Laxman Prasad motivated the youth to seize every opportunity for personal and community growth through Rotary and Rotaract.
